sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
Welcome to ClanForge! These Terms of Use govern your access to and use of the ClanForge platform.

By creating an account or using any part of the platform, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use ClanForge.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.content:
To facilitate reading, here are the meanings of the main terms used in this document.

TERMDEFINITION
UserAny person who creates an account or uses the ClanForge platform.
AccountPersonal profile created by the user to access platform services.
GuildGroup of players created and managed within ClanForge.
ContentAny information, text, image, video, file or material published on the platform.
ServiceAll functionalities, tools and resources provided by ClanForge.
ModerationActions taken by ClanForge to maintain the security and proper functioning of the platform.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.content:
By accessing or using ClanForge, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to these Terms, as well as our Privacy Policy and other applicable policies.

If you are using the platform on behalf of a company, organization or guild, you declare that you have authority to accept these Terms on their behalf.

sections.title: Eligibility and Registration
sections.content:
To use ClanForge you must be at least 13 years old. In some countries, the minimum age may be higher.

  • You are old enough to agree to these Terms
  • The information provided is true and accurate
  • You will keep your password secure and not share your account
  • You will notify ClanForge of any unauthorized use

sections.title: User Account
sections.content:
Each user may maintain only one account on ClanForge, unless expressly authorized.

The username cannot contain offensive words, impersonate others, represent trademarks without authorization, or contain personally identifiable information.

sections.title: Public Profile
sections.content:
Your account includes a public profile with information such as username, avatar, banner, biography, guilds, achievements and ranking.

ClanForge offers privacy controls that allow you to manage who can view your information, send messages and invite to guilds.

sections.title: Guilds
sections.content:
Any user can create a Guild, as long as they respect the platform rules.

The Guild leader is responsible for its members, published content and violations committed on behalf of the group.

A Guild can be deleted by the leader or by ClanForge in case of serious violation of the Terms.

sections.title: User Content
sections.content:
You remain the owner of all content you publish on the platform.

When publishing content, you grant ClanForge a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to display and distribute it within the platform.

Prohibited content includes:

  • Materials that infringe copyright
  • Illegal, hateful or discriminatory content
  • Malware, phishing or harmful scripts
  • Spam or unauthorized advertising

sections.title: Private Messages
sections.content:
Private messages between users are confidential. However, ClanForge may access them when there is a report, suspicion of illegal activity or judicial requirement.

ClanForge may impose limits on the number of messages sent per day to prevent spam and abuse.

sections.title: Community Conduct
sections.content:
Prohibited behaviors include:

  • Spam, bots and unauthorized automation
  • Harassment, hate speech and threats
  • Fraud, phishing and malware
  • Doxxing and ranking manipulation
  • Selling or sharing accounts

Violations may result in content removal, warning, suspension, ban or account deletion.

sections.title: Reports and Moderation
sections.content:
Any user can report content or behavior that violates the Terms.

Penalties range from warning to permanent ban based on severity and recurrence.

Penalized users may request review through official channels.

sections.title: Achievements and Rankings
sections.content:
The achievements, XP, badges and rankings system has no monetary value and cannot be transferred or sold.

ClanForge may change scores, requirements and rules at any time to maintain platform integrity.

sections.title: Sweepstakes and Events
sections.content:
ClanForge may hold sweepstakes and events with prizes. Each has specific rules published at the time of publication.

ClanForge may cancel or modify sweepstakes at any time.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content:
All visual elements, code, design, logo and brand of ClanForge are exclusive property of the platform.

You may not copy, modify, distribute or create derivative products without express authorization.

sections.title: Third-Party Games
sections.content:
ClanForge has no affiliation with developers or publishers of registered games, except for official partnerships.

All game trademarks belong to their respective owners.

ClanForge is not responsible for content, policies or technical issues of third-party games.

sections.title: Platform Availability
sections.content:
ClanForge strives to keep the platform available, but there is no guarantee of continuous availability.

The platform may become unavailable due to maintenance, failures, attacks, updates or force majeure.

sections.title: Suspension and Termination
sections.content:
ClanForge may suspend or terminate accounts that seriously violate the Terms.

Users may request account deletion at any time. After deletion, all data will be lost.

sections.title: Limitation of Liability
sections.content:
ClanForge shall not be liable for direct, indirect or consequential damages arising from the use of the platform.

Total liability shall not exceed the amount paid in the previous 12 months or $100.00.

sections.title: Changes to Terms
sections.content:
ClanForge may change these Terms periodically. Significant changes will be communicated by email or notification.

Changes take effect 30 days after publication. Continued use constitutes acceptance.

sections.title: Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
sections.content:
These Terms of Use are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.

In the event of any controversy arising from the use of the ClanForge platform that cannot be resolved amicably, the court of Novo Hamburgo, State of Rio Grande do Sul, shall have jurisdiction, with express renunciation of any other, however privileged it may be, except where applicable legislation mandatorily requires a different jurisdiction.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content: ClanForge ("we", "our" or "platform") is committed to protecting your privacy and personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect the information you provide or that we automatically collect when you use our services.

sections.title: What data we collect
sections.content:
We collect different types of data to provide the best possible experience on ClanForge.

Data provided by the user

  • Name — used to personalize your profile
  • Nickname — your public identifier on the platform
  • Email — for account creation and password recovery
  • Password — stored encrypted (hash)
  • Photo / Avatar — image that represents you publicly
  • Banner — profile background image
  • Biography — descriptive text about you
  • Country and language — for localized content
  • Social media links — voluntarily shared
  • Published content — texts, comments, posts and guides

Data generated during use

  • Guilds — guilds you create or participate in
  • Achievements and badges — medals and recognitions
  • Private messages — content exchanged with other users
  • Friends list — established connections
  • Notifications — notification records
  • Comments and likes — content interactions
  • Login history — access dates and times

Data collected automatically

  • IP address — for security and analytics
  • Browser and OS — technical identification
  • Language and timezone — for personalization
  • Device type — desktop, tablet or mobile
  • Cookies and identifiers — for functionality and security
  • Server logs — automatic technical records

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.content:
Each collected data has a specific purpose:

PurposeDescription
Create and manage your accountAllow your registration, login and account maintenance
Authenticate your identityEnsure you are who you claim to be
Protect against fraudIdentify and block suspicious activities
Personalize experienceDisplay content in your language and recommend guilds
ModerationAnalyze reports and apply rules
SecurityMonitor access and detect intrusions
StatisticsUnderstand how the platform is used
SupportAnswer questions and resolve issues
CommunicationsNotify about important changes
Legal obligationsComply with legal requirements

We do not use your data for significant automated decisions or advertising profiles without consent.

sections.title: Legal basis (LGPD)
sections.content:
ClanForge processes your data in compliance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei nº 13.709/2018 — LGPD).

Legal BasisApplication
Consent (art. 7º, I)When you accept our Policy and non-essential cookies
Contract execution (art. 7º, V)To create your account and provide services
Legal obligation (art. 7º, II)To comply with legal and judicial requirements
Exercise of rights (art. 7º, VI)To protect ClanForge and users' rights
Legitimate interest (art. 7º, IX)For security, fraud prevention and service improvement

You may revoke your consent at any time.

sections.title: Data sharing
sections.content:
ClanForge does not sell your personal data to third parties.

We may share data in the following situations:

  • Service providers — companies that help us operate the platform
  • Public authorities — when required by law or court order
  • With consent — when you expressly authorize
  • Corporate transfers — in case of merger or acquisition

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.content:
ClanForge uses third-party services to operate:

  • Firebase (Google) — Authentication, Firestore, Storage and Hosting
  • Cloudflare — DDoS protection, CDN and network security
  • Google Analytics — usage statistics (when enabled)
  • Google reCAPTCHA — bot protection
  • Resend — transactional email sending

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content:
Cookies are small files stored in your browser.

TypePurpose
NecessaryEssential for platform functionality
FunctionalRemember your preferences (language, settings)
PerformanceHelp improve the platform (Google Analytics)
MarketingNot currently used

You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

sections.title: Data retention
sections.content:
Your data is kept for the time necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy.

  • Service necessity — while your account is active
  • Legal obligations — deadlines determined by law
  • Security — logs kept for investigations

After account deletion, personal data is removed within 30 days. Backups may contain data for up to 90 days.

sections.title: Your rights (LGPD)
sections.content:
As a data subject, you may:

  • Confirm and access — request a copy of your data
  • Correct — request correction of incorrect data
  • Update — update information on the platform
  • Anonymize, block or delete — request data removal
  • Portability — request transfer to another service
  • Revoke consent — at any time
  • Information about sharing — know with whom we share
  • Object — oppose processing based on legitimate interest

Contact us at privacy@clanforge.com. We will respond within 15 days.

sections.title: Account deletion
sections.content:
When requesting deletion:

  • Profile and personal data are removed or anonymized
  • Guilds, achievements and rankings are unlinked
  • Private messages may remain visible to others
  • Guild content may remain without identification

Data retained by legal obligation (e.g.: access records for 6 months) may remain for the required period.

sections.title: Data security
sections.content:
Measures adopted by ClanForge:

  • Encryption — HTTPS (SSL/TLS) on all transmissions
  • Access control — restricted and authorized access
  • Monitoring — access and intrusion attempt logs
  • Firebase Security — database security rules
  • Cloudflare — DDoS protection
  • Regular backups — to ensure data integrity
  • Encrypted passwords — bcrypt algorithm

sections.title: Children and adolescents
sections.content:
ClanForge is not directed at children under 13 years of age.

If you are between 13 and 18 years old, we recommend that your parents or guardians be aware of this Policy.

We do not intentionally collect data from children under 13. If we identify an account in this age group, we will delete the data and close the account.

sections.title: International transfer
sections.content:
Some providers may store data in other countries (e.g.: Google Firebase and Cloudflare in the US).

We adopt measures such as standard contractual clauses and periodic provider assessment to ensure adequate protection.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.content:
We may update this Policy periodically.

  • Updated version will be published on the platform
  • Significant changes will be communicated by email
  • Changes take effect in 30 days

Continued use after the effective date constitutes acceptance.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content:
For questions about privacy and data protection:

  • Privacy: privacy@clanforge.com
  • Legal: legal@clanforge.com
  • General: contato@clanforge.com

sections.title: Applicable law
sections.content:
This Policy is governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil, especially the LGPD (Lei nº 13.709/2018) and the Marco Civil da Internet (Lei nº 12.965/2014).

Disputes will be resolved in the court of Novo Hamburgo, Rio Grande do Sul.
